subject.title: Require explicit Keychain interaction for Chromium cookies

question: Should SweetCookieKit adopt `BrowserCookieKeychainAccessGate.withUserInteractionDisallowed` as the public host API and permanently stop label fallback after the first interactive failure?
rationale: The implementation is now internally coherent, but the public API shape and intentional fallback tradeoff are package-contract choices that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt scoped policy
options.body: Keep the revised TaskLocal API, released interactive default, and one-shot interactive boundary, then require live macOS proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the API first
options.body: Request a different public surface or fallback contract before asking the contributor for final runtime proof.

options.title: Decline new policy surface
options.body: Keep the existing global disable switch and released interactive behavior without adding a per-import policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped policy
recommendation.body: Keep the revised TaskLocal API, released interactive default, and one-shot interactive boundary, then require live macOS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the public package upgrade contract make this the clearest available decision owner.
